logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the B verification memo (WO-01 water-reclamation pump module selection). A horizontal-panel analytical figure: left panel is a bar chart of measured energy per common acceptance run (kWh) for the four qualifying candidates — P2 12 kWh, P3 52, P1 56, P4 58 — drawn on a common 0–60 kWh axis, with the winner bar P2 highlighted in the accent teal (#0E4C66) and challengers in muted gray. Each challenger bar carries a labeled gap annotation to P2 (+40, +44, +46 kWh) and a small quality/defect tag (P2 q97/1d, P3 q80/3d, P1 q84/4d, P4 q81/0d). A footnote notes P4 consumes about 4.8× P2's energy on the identical fixed flow/head duty. Right panel is a verification status column from the memo: green checks for recomputed eligibility gates, confirmed ranking P2–P3–P1–P4, verified gaps, A's table matching the trusted source, the P4/P2 ratio, and no arithmetic slips; amber warnings for unverified cost, delivery, maintenance and field reliability, and for the open question of whether P2's single defect is cosmetic or functional. No decorative art; every element serves the client's lowest-energy qualification decision.
